anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: question
The workspace-change handler in `ui/report-view.ts` currently keeps active filters, and no setting selects anything else. The new policy will be a key under `settings/resolver.ts:12`, read through the existing path into `ui/report-view.ts:30`. Which behavior should the report view apply when the user switches workspaces?
A) clear all filters on every workspace switch
B) preserve all active filters across switches
C) restore each workspace's last filters
Recommendation: B - it matches what the handler does today, so the resolver key encodes existing behavior with no per-workspace filter state to store, migrate, or invalidate.
